about_the_game:
Overview: "Director, Please Give More Guidance" is the world's first director simulator on Steam. You will become a director, going through a series of processes from casting to exploring the inner world of actors, exerting every effort to create a perfect work. Six women with different personalities will bring changes to your movie career. Director, please give more guidance.

About the Game: "Director, Please Give More Guidance" is the world's first director simulator on Steam. You will become a director, experiencing a range of content from casting to uncovering the inner world of actors, striving to produce a flawless piece. Six women with diverse characters will impact your movie journey.

Is she the innocent and lovely campus goddess? Du Yuchun Is she the lively and spirited rich girl? Lin Xiaoxiao Is she the gentle and graceful intellectual beauty? Zhu Keke Is she the pure and charming personal assistant? Qiao Qiqi Is she the young and famous rising star? Sun Qiansong Is she the domineering and wealthy businesswoman? Chen Yue

Product Features:

  • First - person immersive experience - Experience the joys and sorrows of a director's life in the first person throughout the game.

  • Multiple plot branches - Each character brings different story experiences.

  • Real - person, real - scene shooting - Fully restore the daily life scenes of a director.

  • Multiple protagonists to pursue - Six beautiful women with different styles, and the romantic stories between you and them.

  • Hidden stories - Waiting for you to discover.
